_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d4, d8; applied 5 Oct 2026). Blueprint H3 (SFX word -> fragment text). core = counts toward the page's 'Evidence 0/5'; optional = extra context (A3, A15). 'puzzle' = Echo Path that guards it (PLAN 3.3); null = click-to-reveal. Light-only fragments (A1 spirit-light) are marked "light": true on the fragment in content/pages/<witness>.json and are always optional. witness 'archive' = granted automatically in the Hidden Archive; never counted on a page or toward the epilogue.

evidence.text: Teal residue on the relay plate. It matches the Echo Lantern network.
The bell rang at 2:17. The rope never moved.
School clock, tower clock, wall clock: all 2:17.
Lantern resonance hums in the bell frame.
Mira's ledger, by her own watch: '2:31. Nia's cot is empty.'
The hand at Nia's door held an apprentice lantern staff.
Under the light: 'Elias Vane, apprentice.' Scraped out.
Nia Vane: sickroom. Clinic record, in Mira's register.
Ferry log: full current at 2:10.
Arun's wind-up watch ran past 2:17. It stopped at 2:31.
Emergency sluice: opens when the lantern runs hot. Drains to the lantern-house.
Footsteps on the dry riverbed, minutes after the bell. Toward the lantern-house.
Nia's silver hairclip, snagged on the walker's coat.
Under the light: 'E.V.' scratched into the lantern case.
An echo in the water: a child's voice, counting lanterns.
Echo Lantern spool: records, extracts and transfers memory.
Village map: 32 anchor nodes, one for every soul.
Under the light, rule two: 'A lantern lights for one hand only.'
Nia Vane: memory fading. Single-node trials failed.
2:17: link opened with the apprentice staff. Operator: E. Vane.
2:31: all 32 nodes fire at once.
Memory field overload. Not even the river could cool it.
Master log: 'Anchors bind in fourteen minutes. Then fetch Nia. If it fails, someone has to remember it.'
Self-purge, keyed to the apprentice staff: erase the operator's name, face and record.
Purge list: thirty-two anchors' memories of the operator. And the operator's own.
The unsigned case request, beside the apprentice log of E. Vane.
